output.description: output only the field specified. Multiple such options can be supplied if required. Choices are: mean, median, std, std_rv, min, max, count. Useful for use in scripts. Both std options refer to the unbiased (sample) standard deviation. For complex data, min, max and std are calculated separately for real and imaginary parts, std_rv is based on the real valued variance (equals sqrt of sum of variances of imaginary and real parts).
output.title: output

mask.description: only perform computation within the specified binary mask image.
mask.title: mask

ignorezero.description: ignore zero values during statistics calculation
ignorezero.title: ignorezero

allvolumes.description: generate statistics across all image volumes, rather than one set of statistics per image volume
allvolumes.title: allvolumes

quiet.description: do not display information messages or progress status; alternatively, this can be achieved by setting the MRTRIX_QUIET environment variable to a non-empty string.
quiet.title: quiet

force.description: force overwrite of output files (caution: using the same file as input and output might cause unexpected behaviour).
force.title: force

nthreads.description: use this number of threads in multi-threaded applications (set to 0 to disable multi-threading).
nthreads.title: nthreads

key.description: temporarily set the value of an MRtrix config file entry.
key.title: key

value.description: temporarily set the value of an MRtrix config file entry.
value.title: value

config.description: temporarily set the value of an MRtrix config file entry.
config.title: config

help.description: display this information page and exit.
help.title: help

image.description: the input image from which statistics will be computed.
